newsitem.title: USA: NHL-ISLANDERS' PILON SUSPENDED TWO GAMES.
newsitem.headline: NHL-ISLANDERS' PILON SUSPENDED TWO GAMES.

text.p: The NHL suspended New York Islanders defenceman Richard Pilon for two games and fined him $1,000 Monday for taking a series of baseball-like swings with his stick at Pittsburgh Penguins centre Mario Lemieux.
Pilon has already served one game of the suspension as he was forced to sit out Saturday's game at Tampa Bay while he awaited Monday's hearing.
Pilon was given a match penalty for his actions, which came in the third period of New York's 5-2 loss to Pittsburgh Friday night.

"Although Mr. Pilon was provoked on the play by Mr. Lemieux, there can be no excuse for a player using a two-handed baseball grip to swing at his opponent," said NHL Senior Vice President and Director of Hockey Operations Brian Burke.
Pilon will serve the final game of his suspension Monday night when the Islanders play the New York Rangers.
